Planning Mode

What I want to get done this week

The list you keep by hand, and the one CoachClaw reads before it builds the week. A ticked box asks CoachClaw to find time for something. It does not mean the thing is finished — that is what Done is for. Untick an item and it stays here, out of this week's schedule, waiting for a week you want it in.
My work schedule
Step 1: the hours you are at work, so the week is built around them and never over them. Photograph the rota and the shifts are read off it — then check them here, because a misread 8 for a 9 is a week planned an hour wrong. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
Add to the list
What CoachClaw reads
Step 2 of the weekly build, exactly as it leaves this page. Items with no duration are scheduled as an hour until you give them one.
The week
Steps 4 and 5: every ticked item placed in time that is actually free, around your calendar, your work schedule and everything else already fixed. Nothing is on the calendar until you accept it.
How the week gets built
  1. Work schedule — the days and hours you are at work, read off a photo of the rota or typed in, so nothing is planned over them.
  2. This checklist — every ticked item, with its duration, priority and preferred times.
  3. Existing commitments — calendar events, scheduled tasks and anything else already fixed.
  4. Free time — realistic windows around all of that, not every empty minute.
  5. The week — ticked items placed in those windows.
  6. Your review — accept it, move something, or send an item back to this list.
